parameters.description:
Whether to calculate the intercept for this model. If set
to false, no intercept will be used in calculations.
parameters.name: fit_intercept

parameters.description:
Instead of computing with a set of cardinality 'n choose k', where n is
the number of samples and k is the number of subsamples (at least
number of features), consider only a stochastic subpopulation of a
given maximal size if 'n choose k' is larger than max_subpopulation.
For other than small problem sizes this parameter will determine
memory usage and runtime if n_subsamples is not changed. Note that the
data type should be int but floats such as 1e4 can be accepted too.
parameters.name: max_subpopulation

parameters.description:
Number of samples to calculate the parameters. This is at least the
number of features (plus 1 if fit_intercept=True) and the number of
samples as a maximum. A lower number leads to a higher breakdown
point and a low efficiency while a high number leads to a low
breakdown point and a high efficiency. If None, take the
minimum number of subsamples leading to maximal robustness.
If n_subsamples is set to n_samples, Theil-Sen is identical to least
squares.
parameters.name: n_subsamples

parameters.description: Maximum number of iterations for the calculation of spatial median.
parameters.name: max_iter

parameters.description:
A random number generator instance to define the state of the random
permutations generator. Pass an int for reproducible output across
multiple function calls.
See :term:`Glossary <random_state>`.
parameters.name: random_state
parameters.type_doc: int, RandomState instance or None, default=None

parameters.description:
Number of CPUs to use during the cross validation.
``None`` means 1 unless in a :obj:`joblib.parallel_backend` context.
``-1`` means using all processors. See :term:`Glossary <n_jobs>`
for more details.
parameters.name: n_jobs

parameters.description: Verbose mode when fitting the model.
parameters.name: verbose
